parent_objective: audit support-first measured execution result before ranking or paper claims
blocked_by: M1880 result must be audited before interpretation
supersedes: direct support-first controller-family ranking after measured execution

public_gates: M1881 must use only M1880 artifacts and must not rerun rollout
M1881 must audit target counts failure rows metric completeness guardrails and role outcome distribution
M1881 must decide whether to admit localization, scenario repair, branch synthesis, or a later ranking design
M1881 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles rank controller families or claim paper-level evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits completed 2160-cell support-first public diagnostic execution and synthesizes the support-first measured-execution branch before interpretation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit and branch synthesis only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if execution pass criteria are not actually satisfied
stop if outcomes are too dominated for ranking
stop if metric semantics are insufficient for paper-route comparison
stop if workflow cadence requires branch synthesis
fallback_plan: route to outcome localization if outcome dominance blocks ranking
route to scenario or metric repair if audit finds task-quality issues
route to ranking design only if role outcomes are interpretable

training_stage.stage_objective: support-first measured execution result audit and branch synthesis
admission_evidence: M1880 reports 2160 episodes, zero failures, complete metrics, and clean guardrails
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1881 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for localization, repair, ranking design, or synthesis
next_stage_criteria: ranking remains blocked unless explicitly admitted by audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1881 audits public diagnostic outcomes and does not prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: Audit must preserve profile controls for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If outcomes are dominated or weak, route to localization or scenario-quality repair, not self-ID claim weakening.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1880 can be audited as a complete support-first measured execution before interpretation.
success_criteria: M1881 verifies execution pass criteria and outcome distribution
M1881 makes the next route explicit
M1881 preserves no-reset no-rollout no-training no-ranking and no-paper-claim guardrails
failure_criteria: audit ranks profiles or claims paper-level evidence

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1880 support-first measured execution artifacts without reset or rollout

decision_rule: M1881 passes if it audits M1880 and chooses the next route without reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
